correctness.rationale: For nonzero monic F_q[T] factors under the SAME cutoff d, the parameterization (f1,f2,f3,f4)=(gu,hv,gv,hu) with monic gcd(u,v)=1 is unique; deg(g)=a, deg(h)=b, and residual degrees <=d-max(a,b). Polynomial Mobius series 1-qz gives the exact coprime-pair count C_L=(q^(2L+1)-1)/(q-1), including L=0. Thus N(a,b)=(q^(2d+1-|a-b|)-q^(a+b))/(q-1) and the stated summed scalar energy follow. For (A,J=A-B), the unnormalized joint weight W is pointwise bounded by R=q^(-|J|); boundary omitted mass <=2q/(q-1)^2 and interior correction <=q/(q-1)^2. Normalizing R of mass (d+1)(q+1)/(q-1) yields the stated TV upper bound 3q/((q²-1)(d+1)), uniformly in q,d; weak limit follows for fixed q. Independent multiplication+gcd enumeration matched every degree-pair count for F2 d=0..3 and F3 d=1..2. Finite tests do not prove infinite field/degree scope.
residual_risks: The TV constant is a valid upper bound, not established sharp; the continuum uniform convergence is weak, not TV.
Independent enumeration is bounded and does not certify all prime powers or all cutoffs.
